definitions.gloss: to submit, to present, to turn in, to file
definitions.explanation: To formally hand in or present documents, reports, applications, or other materials to an authority, organization, or instructor.

examples.japanese: ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{提出|ていしゅつ}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the documents by tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{税務署|ぜいむしょ}→税務署：13782_zeimusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I submitted the tax return documents to the tax office.

notes:
One of the most essential formal verbs for students, office workers, and anyone dealing with bureaucracy. Used constantly in school, work, and government contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧: submission deadline
- ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}{書類|しょるい}→提出書類：23682_teishutsushorui⟧: documents to be submitted
- ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: place of submission
- ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}{物|ぶつ}→提出物：24636_teishutsubutsu⟧: submitted items, homework/assignments
- ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a bill (legislation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to turn in, to hand in — casual, everyday equivalent
- {提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit — formal, used in official and academic contexts
- ⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for — specifically for requesting permission or a license
